title: Check in
closed: Check-in has closed for this game.

gps.title: Checking your location
gps.intro: Stay where you are. We take three location readings a few seconds apart.

success.title: You’re checked in
success.method: {method, select, gps {Confirmed by GPS} qr {Confirmed by QR code} peer {Confirmed by teammates} host {Confirmed by the host} other {Confirmed}}
success.subtitle: Have a great game.

unconfirmed.title: We can’t confirm you’re at the venue yet
unconfirmed.body: Move into the open or try another way.

reject.not_participant: You’re not on the player list for this game.
reject.outside_window: Check-in isn’t open right now. It opens {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before the start.
reject.insufficient_samples: We need a few more location readings. Stay where you are and try again.
reject.samples_too_close: We need a little more time to check your location. Wait a few seconds and try again.
reject.low_accuracy: Your location isn’t precise enough yet. Move into the open or try another way.
reject.too_far: We can’t confirm you’re at the venue yet. Move closer or try another way.
reject.spread_too_large: Your location readings were too far apart. Stay in one spot and try again.
reject.suspected_spoofing: We can’t confirm your location this way. Try another way to check in.
reject.invalid_qr: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again.
reject.expired_qr: That code has expired. Ask the host for the current one.
reject.not_host: Only the host can do this.
reject.insufficient_peers: We need more teammates to confirm. Ask another player who is checked in.
reject.reciprocal_only: Teammates you confirmed can’t be the only ones to confirm you. Ask someone else.
reject.blocked_pair: We couldn’t use that confirmation. Ask a different player.

qr.hint: Point your camera at the code on the host’s screen.
qr.tokenHint: Can’t scan? Ask the host to copy the check-in code and send it to you, then paste it here.

peer.hint: We’ll ask players who are already checked in to confirm you’re here.
peer.waiting: Waiting for {needed, plural, one {# confirmation} other {# confirmations}} · {received} received
peer.confirmHint: Confirm only players you can see at the venue right now.
peer.confirmed: {count, plural, one {Thanks. # confirmation so far.} other {Thanks. # confirmations so far.}}
peer.waitingNeeded: Waiting for {needed, plural, one {# teammate} other {# teammates}} who are checked in to confirm you.

location.title: Location helps confirm you’re here
location.body: We check your location a few times while you’re at the venue. We don’t follow you afterwards.
location.denied: Location is off. Scan the host’s QR code or ask a teammate instead.

camera.title: Camera access
camera.body: We use the camera only to scan the host’s QR code.
camera.denied: Camera is off. Enter the 6-digit code instead.

background.title: Check in automatically
background.body: If you turn this on, Sport Talent uses your location in the background to notice when you arrive at a game you joined. It only looks for you near the venue, around the game time. You can turn it off at any time in Settings.

offline.queued: We’ll confirm when you’re back online.

host.title: Check-in code
host.instruction: Players scan this to check in. The code refreshes every {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
host.fallbackCode: Can’t scan? Copy the code and send it
host.qrA11y: Check-in QR code for players to scan
host.screenOn: Keep this screen on and turn up the brightness so players can scan it.

geofence.title: Sport Talent
geofence.body: You’re near the game — tap to check in.

fallbacks: {count, plural, one {Try the other way below.} other {Try one of the other ways below.}}
